_comentario: Tabela do povoamento: cada cidade exterior do cartucho 1 com o
elenco que a leva ao piso de NPCs da lei do Gui de 07/09/2026.

falas: KURT makes BALLS out of\nAPRICORNS. By hand, one at a time.
SLOWPOKE WELL is under the town.\nThe SLOWPOKE are back, thankfully.
ILEX FOREST is west through the\ngate. It is easy to get lost.
The GYM here is bugs.\nFire and Flying moves end it fast.
DRAGON'S DEN is behind the GYM.\nOnly the clan goes down there.
The ICE PATH is the only way\nnorth, and it is slippery.
Dragon moves are answered by\nIce, and by other dragons.
This city sits in a crater.\nThe lava never comes up here.
The ferry from the dock reaches\nIRON ISLAND. Ask the sailor.
The LIBRARY holds every myth\nSINNOH ever wrote down.
This city was built for cargo.\nThe bridges lift for the ships.
The DEPARTMENT STORE has a floor\nfor almost everything.
The GAME CORNER eats coins.\nI would know. Ask my wallet.
The shrine in the cave is older\nthan any record we keep.
ROUTE 210 east, ROUTE 211 west.\nMountains both ways.
The GYM here is all water.\nElectric moves cut it short.
The BIKE SHOP is famous.\nThe prices are famous too.
ROUTE 24 goes north, ROUTE 9 east.\nBoth are crawling with trainers.
CHERRYGROVE is the first city\nmost trainers ever see.
The sea is right there. I have\nfished this shore for forty years.
The MART here has the basics.\nPOTIONS and BALLS, mostly.
ROUTE 30 goes north to VIOLET.\nROUTE 29 goes back east.
The GYM here fights bare handed.\nFlying and Psychic answer that.
No road reaches CIANWOOD.\nYou come by water or not at all.
The PHARMACY has medicine you\nwill not find anywhere else.
CLIFF EDGE GATE is north.\nThe rocks past it are worse.
ROUTE 41 east is open sea,\nwhirlpools and all.
The LAB revives Pokémon from\nfossils. I still find that mad.
The whole island sits on a\nvolcano. You get used to the heat.
The MANSION has been empty for\nyears. Somebody left notes inside.
A Fire GYM on a volcano.\nOf course it is.
Water and Rock moves put out\nfire fast. Free advice.
ROUTE 20 runs east from here,\nall of it open sea.
The sand is warm even at night.\nI sleep out here sometimes.
No road reaches DEWFORD.\nMR. BRINEY brings everyone in.
GRANITE CAVE is on ROUTE 106,\njust north of the beach.
The tide here is strong.\nWatch where you stand.
The GYM fights in the dark.\nFlying and Psychic end it fast.
I make sand castles all day.\nThe sea takes them all night.
The TOWN HALL keeps the island\ngossip. All of it.
The BURNED TOWER still smells of\nsmoke, after all these years.
TIN TOWER stands north.\nThe sages keep its stairs.
The THEATRE puts on shows for\nthe whole city.
VICTORY ROAD is the only way up.\nThere is no shortcut.
I have healed here four times\ntoday. I am not going in yet.
A city with no houses, only a\ngate and a mountain.
The POKéMON LEAGUE takes eight\nbadges and nothing less.
ROUTE 128 west is deep water.\nYou surfed it to get here.
The cliffs here are the tallest\nin HOENN. Look up.
Everyone who reaches this beach\nhas a story worth hearing.
Rest before the road.\nInside, there is nowhere to sit.
My sister went up this morning.\nI am waiting right here.
I fish this shore and watch\nchampions walk past. Good life.
PROF. COZMO studies the sky\nfrom this dusty little town.
Ash falls here when the volcano\nstirs. We sweep, and go on.
The MOVE RELEARNER lives here.\nForgotten moves come back.
ROUTE 114 west, ROUTE 113 east.\nThe ash road is east.
The BATTLE TENT takes anyone.\nWinning is another matter.
Soot from the ash road can be\ncollected. Glass is made from it.
I wrote my name in the ash and\nthe wind took it.
FIVE ISLE MEADOW is east.\nBerries grow wild out there.
The WATER LABYRINTH is north.\nPeople trade odd Pokémon there.
The harbour is the only way in\nand the only way out.
Five islands down, two to go.\nThat is how I count my life.
It rains here more than on the\nother islands. I like it.
Berries a Pokémon holds get\neaten in battle, on their own.
I found a shell on the beach\nshaped like a POKé BALL.
Nothing hurries here. Not even\nthe ferry.
The MEADOW north is one long\nfield of flowers.
The FLOWER SHOP sells more than\nflowers. Ask about accessories.
Bees come with the flowers.\nSo do the Pokémon that eat bees.
Every house here sits in a tree.\nThe ladders take getting used to.
The GYM LEADER flies.\nElectric, Ice and Rock ground her.
ROUTE 119 west is a jungle.\nROUTE 120 east has a bridge.
Something invisible sits on the\nbridge east of town. I swear it.
ICEFALL CAVE is cold enough to\nhurt. Do not go in tired.
The DAY CARE takes Pokémon and\ngives them back stronger.
Ice types fold to Fire, Rock,\nSteel and Fighting moves.
LORELEI lives here. A real ELITE\nFOUR member, on our island.
Four ships a day, all of them\nlate. Island time.
The SAFARI ZONE is behind that\ngate. No battling in there.
The GYM LEADER uses poison.\nBring antidotes, not excuses.
The WARDEN lives over there.\nHe cares for the park by himself.
ROUTE 19 is south, and it is\nall water. You will need SURF.
Past this door the ELITE FOUR\nare waiting. No second tries.
I climbed VICTORY ROAD twice.\nI turned back twice.
Heal here. There is nowhere to\nrest once you go in.
Four champions in a row, then\nthe CHAMPION. Think about that.
The wind up here never stops.\nIt clears the head.
I cover every challenger who\nwalks through that gate.
Bring full restores. Bring more\nthan you think you need.
My brother went in this morning.\nI am still standing here.
The hot spring cures anything a\nlong walk causes.
The TOWER is a grave, not a\nlandmark. Walk quietly in there.
MR. FUJI takes in Pokémon that\nlost their trainers.
My friend says the tower is\nhaunted. I say he is scared.
Ghost types ignore Normal moves.\nBring something else.
Three roads meet here: ROUTE 8,\nROUTE 10 and ROUTE 12.
This town is small and sad,\nand it does not pretend otherwise.
I leave flowers at the tower\nevery week. It helps.
PROF. BIRCH studies Pokémon in\nthe field, not at a desk.
Two houses and a lab. That is\nthe whole town, and it is enough.
ROUTE 101 is north. Every\ntrainer from here starts on it.
The moving van came here once.\nI still remember the noise.
The mountain air keeps this town\ncold most of the year.
The shop here sells souvenirs.\nRead the labels twice.
The GYM freezes. Fire and Rock\nwork. So do Steel and Fighting.
ROUTE 43 north leads to the\nLAKE OF RAGE.
Snow makes every fight slower.\nPatience wins here.
I like the quiet. Most people\nleave for GOLDENROD.
PROF. ELM's lab is the reason\nanyone knows this town.
They call it the town where the\nwinds of a new beginning blow.
ROUTE 27 is east, and it is wet.\nROUTE 29 west is dry.
I watched three trainers leave\nfrom here. All came back changed.
Every house here knows every\nother house. Keep no secrets.
ROUTE 29 has soft grass and soft\nPokémon. Start there.
Heal at the lab, stock up west.\nThen the road is yours.
OLDALE is the first stop out of\nLITTLEROOT. Rest while you can.
Three roads: 101 south,\n102 west, 103 north.
The MART clerk explains POTIONS\nto everyone. Every single time.
Nothing happens here. That is\nwhy I stayed.
ROUTE 103 has a beach and a\npond. Good for a first team.
A Pokémon that faints still\nearns nothing. Keep them standing.
The PORT is south. Ships leave\nfor far coasts from there.
The LIGHTHOUSE keeps this whole\nharbour alive at night.
The GYM here is steel.\nFire, Fighting and Ground bite it.
The CAFE by the water is the\nbest thing in this city.
ROUTE 40 west is all sea.\nROUTE 39 north is all farmland.
The ferry from here reaches all\nthe islands. Ask at the harbour.
The machine in that house links\nour network to KANTO.
KINDLE ROAD is east, and it\nclimbs. Bring water.
TREASURE BEACH is south.\nThe tide leaves things behind.
ONE ISLAND is the first of the\nseven. The quietest, too.
The hot spring up the road is\nworth the walk.
I want to see all seven islands\nbefore I grow up.
The whole town floats on logs.\nMind your step at night.
The currents past town push you\nwhere they please. Mind them.
No grass, no trees, no roads.\nJust water and neighbours.
ROUTE 131 east, ROUTE 132 west.\nBoth need SURF.
I learned to swim before I\nlearned to walk here.
Storms shake the logs, and the\nhouses hold. Every time.
The fish here come right up to\nthe boards. They are not shy.
PROF. OAK's lab is right there.
He knows everything about\nPokémon. Everything!
PALLET TOWN is tiny, but every\ngreat trainer starts small.
The sea opens up south of town.\nWithout SURF you stop at the sand.
I have lived here all my life.\nQuiet town, loud Pokémon.
ROUTE 1 is north, full of grass.
A fresh team learns fast there.
Everyone who leaves this town\ncomes back with a story.
Walking into tall grass with no\nPokémon is asking for trouble.
The GYM LEADER here trains\nNormal types, and trains hard.
PETALBURG WOODS are west,\nthrough ROUTE 104.
The river runs right through\ntown. Good water, good fish.
The MUSEUM keeps fossils older\nthan any of us.
MT. MOON is east, past ROUTE 3.\nTake something that lights caves.
Rock Pokémon are so heavy.\nI can not even lift a GEODUDE.
Rock types hate Water and Grass.\nRemember that at the GYM.
PEWTER CITY is grey as stone,\nbut the people here are warm.
PROF. ROWAN's lab studies how\nPokémon change as they grow.
The beach south is ROUTE 219.\nAll sand and sea from there.
The MART here is small but it\nnever runs out of POTIONS.
ROUTE 202 north leads to\nJUBILIFE. Big city, loud city.
TRAINER TOWER is north. Floor\nafter floor, no rest between.
The TANOBY RUINS hold writing\nnobody has finished reading.
SEVAULT CANYON is south, and the\nrock down there bites.
Last island of the seven.\nThe road ends at the water.
I came for a week. That was\nfour years ago.
The tower keeps a record of\nevery run. Mine is bad.
From here you can see nothing\nbut sea. I find that restful.
The WATER PATH east splits in\nthree. Choose wrong and you swim.
PATTERN BUSH is a maze of hedges\nand bug catchers.
ALTERING CAVE changes what lives\ninside it. Nobody agrees why.
The DOTTED HOLE is sealed.\nOnly the right key opens it.
I swim the channel every morning.\nThe current is honest work.
Six is my favourite number now\nthat I live here.
Sleep in the PokéCENTER, not on\nthe beach. Trust me.
The sunsets here are the reason\nI never left.
The TEMPLE is north, and it is\ncolder inside than out.
No road comes here. Only the\nlakefront path west.
The snow never melts. I have\nnever seen the ground.
The RUINS under this town go\ndeeper than the town is wide.
The DAY CARE takes two Pokémon\nand looks after both.
The NEWS PRESS prints stories\nabout trainers. Maybe yours.
The walkways above the street\nkeep the sand off our feet.
The LIGHTHOUSE lens is solar.\nThe whole city runs on sun.
TWINLEAF is two houses and a\nlot of grass. It suits us.
ROUTE 201 north, ROUTE 220 south.\nOne is dry, one is not.
When I grow up I will leave,\nand then I will come back.
LAKE VERITY is not far.\nPeople say things live in it.
CAPE BRINK is north. Old moves\nare remembered up there.
The GAME CORNER here is small,\nbut the prizes are honest.
The water between the islands\nis deeper than it looks.
The air here is the cleanest in\nall of HOENN. Breathe it in.
RUSTURF TUNNEL runs west from\nthe edge of town.
The FRIENDSHIP RATER tells you\nhow much your Pokémon like you.
The BATTLE TENT is here.\nThree battles, no healing between.
ROUTE 116 north, ROUTE 117 east.\nBoth are gentle walks.
My grandmother says the wind\nhere carries flower dust.
The harbour never sleeps.\nShips come in at every hour.
The POKéMON FAN CLUB is here.\nMembers talk for hours.
The GYM LEADER fights with\nelectricity. Ground shrugs it off.
ROUTE 11 runs east from the gate.\nDIGLETT are said to live under it.
SPROUT TOWER sways all night.\nThe pillar inside moves it.
The TRAINER SCHOOL is right\nthere. The tests are hard.
The GYM here flies.\nElectric and Rock moves answer it.
Three roads leave VIOLET:\n31 east, 32 south, 36 west.
The TRAINER SCHOOL teaches the\nbasics. I still go there.
The GYM here has been shut for\nyears. Nobody knows the LEADER.
ROUTE 22 runs west, toward the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE road.
North of here the trees close in.\nThat is VIRIDIAN FOREST.
My back hurts. Yours will too,\nif you never sit down.
